name: us023-checklist-mode-inert
description: 023, Phase 6, US4, T005/T103 (contract role-lifecycle-config.md §5, I4/I5/I6): a project in `checklist` mode whose phase_status_map declares a `task` role -- the mapping is recorded, never consumed, and produces exactly one inert note (never a warning, never per ticket). TASKP-3's marker is still in tasks.md, its ticket still in the tracker, but the mirror abandoned it the moment mode switched to checklist -- it never enters the mapping's move set even though the mock declares a reachable, ungated move onto its declared step. Zero moves, one note.

content.text: We need to prove a task-role mapping is recorded but never consumed once a project switches to checklist mode.
As a user, I want the first story.
**Given** a thing **When** it happens **Then** it works
